question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Endavour."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is "Endavour."
 
• **"Endeavour"** means to try hard. (कठोर परिश्रम करना; भरसक प्रयास करना)
 
 
• Example:* She **endeavoured**__ to finish her work on time.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Palpable: **that is easily felt by the senses or the mind. (जिसे इंद्रियों द्वारा महसूस किया जा सके; स्पष्ट, प्रत्यक्ष)
 
• **Reckless: **not thinking about possible bad or dangerous results that could come from your actions. (दुःसाहसी (अपनी हरकतों के संभावित दुष्‍परिणामों या ख़तरों के प्रति लापरवाह))
 
• **Rubbish: **.things that you do not want any more; waste material. (बेकार की चीज़ें; कूड़ा-करकट, रद्दी माल)
